description: Buyer-issued purchase order landed from OCR extraction. Staging record with a human verification gate — not a transactional order document.

fields.description: Retail brand the order is for. NOT the entity that issued the PO. Stored as printed — resolution to the Brand master is a downstream step.
fields.label: Brand

fields.description: Legal entity issuing the order — sourcing arm, agent or brand itself.
fields.label: Buyer / Issuing Entity

fields.description: Primary order number printed on the document.
fields.label: PO / Order Number

fields.description: Date the order was raised.
fields.label: PO Date

fields.description: Firm PO vs framework contract vs call-off. Free text — seen so far: Purchase Order, Contract (Call-off), Framework Agreement.
fields.label: Document Type

fields.description: Project no / contract no / computer reference used for grouping.
fields.label: Secondary Reference

fields.description: Buyer's internal code for PSL.
fields.label: Supplier / Vendor Code

fields.description: Amendment marker. Part of the duplicate key with PO number and buyer entity.
fields.label: Revision / Version

fields.description: Order carries assortment ratio grids. Their pack data lives in Assortment Data — line quantities come from the consolidated colour x size matrix to avoid double counting.
fields.label: Is Assorted

fields.description: Buyer's style reference at order level.
fields.label: Style / Article Code

fields.description: Garment description exactly as printed.
fields.label: Style Description

fields.description: Normalised garment type — feeds Category Intelligence.
fields.label: Product Category

fields.description: Buying season.
fields.label: Season

fields.description: Blend string as printed. Stored raw, normalised downstream.
fields.label: Fabric Composition

fields.description: Knit vs woven, plus knit weight class.
fields.label: Fabric Texture / Construction

fields.description: Sustainability / compliance certification on the order.
fields.label: Certification

fields.description: Tariff code — accuracy anchor for category mapping. Also held at line level where it varies.
fields.label: HS / HTS Code (order level)

fields.description: Manufacturing origin, normalised (e.g. INDE -> India).
fields.label: Country of Origin

fields.description: Buyer's size-grid identifier; drives the size columns.
fields.label: Size Scale / Grid Code

fields.description: Order currency, as an ISO code. Free text — a code that is not in the Currency master still saves, but is flagged in Extraction Notes.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: Default price per unit before line-level overrides.
fields.label: Base / Main Unit Price

fields.description: Total as printed. Reconciled against the sum of child rows below.
fields.label: Total Order Quantity

fields.description: Selling unit. Free text — seen so far: PCS, EA, SU, SET.
fields.label: Unit of Measure

fields.description: Total value as printed. Derived from the lines where the PO does not print one.
fields.label: Total Order Value

fields.description: Payment / LC terms.
fields.label: Payment Terms

fields.description: Computed from the line items on every save. A non-zero variance means the printed totals disagree with the extracted lines — resolve before verifying.
fields.label: Reconciliation

fields.description: Computed less printed.
fields.label: Quantity Variance

fields.description: Computed less printed.
fields.label: Value Variance

fields.description: Trade term plus named port.
fields.label: Incoterm

fields.description: Contractual latest delivery date at order level.
fields.label: Delivery Date (latest)

fields.description: Final warehouse or DC with address.
fields.label: Delivery / Ship-To Location

fields.description: Carriage mode. Free text — seen so far: Sea, Air, Road, Rail.
fields.label: Mode of Transport

fields.description: Nominated freight forwarder.
fields.label: Forwarding Agent

fields.description: Pack / carton / palletisation instruction.
fields.label: Packing Instruction

fields.description: Price tag, RFID or EAN labelling instruction.
fields.label: Labelling / Price Ticket

fields.description: Named counterpart on the buyer side.
fields.label: Buyer / Merchandiser Contact

fields.description: PSL entity named on the order — unit matters.
fields.label: Supplier / Producer

fields.description: Wash / bleach / iron / dry / professional care set.
fields.label: Care Instructions

fields.description: One row per Style x Colour x Size.
fields.label: Line Items

fields.description: Assortment ratio grids as JSON, e.g. [{"code": "A01", "colour": "BEIGE STAR", "assortments": 16, "ratio": {"XS": 1, "S": 3}}]. Pack data only — never summed into line quantities.
fields.label: Assortment Data

fields.description: The uploaded OCR-extracted Excel, kept for audit. Required before the record can be Verified.
fields.label: Source File

fields.description: Which parser template was applied. Drives the mapping. Free text so a new buyer format can be onboarded without a schema change — current templates: KIABI-ITX, Tchibo, DMart.
fields.label: Detected Source Format

fields.description: Human verification gate before the PO is used downstream. Promotion to Verified enforces the full required-field set.
fields.label: Extraction Status

fields.description: Parser warnings, unmapped values, reconciliation mismatches. Text below the auto-checks marker is rewritten on every save.
fields.label: Extraction Notes

fields.description: Raw parser output, kept so a bad extraction can be diagnosed without re-running OCR.
fields.label: Parsed Payload

name: Buyer PO
